description: Permanently delete request files from a Bruno collection. One confirm covers the whole list. Each file is unlinked and cannot be recovered through this server. Only .yml/.bru files inside a detected collection can be deleted. Every path is checked before the first unlink, so one unusable path deletes nothing. The result names each file's outcome. To clear a script and keep the request, use remove_script.

confirm.description: Must be true. Every file in filePaths is deleted permanently.

filePaths.description: Absolute paths to the .yml or .bru request files to delete, from list_requests or get_collection_stats. A one-element list deletes one request.

name: delete_request
title: Delete Requests
